# ToolkitGen - Full System Manifest

> Complete directory of browser-based utilities, hardware benchmarks, and client-side calculators. All processing occurs locally in browser memory with no server telemetry.

## System Details
- Homepage: https://toolkitgen.com
- Framework: Static Astro Architecture
- Execution Boundary: Client-side JavaScript / WebAssembly / Web APIs (WebHID, WebCodecs, WebGPU, WebCrypto)
- Total Active Tools: 148

## Category: Developer / Data

### Crontab Generator & Visualizer
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/cron_job_visualizer
- Summary: The Logic of Cron: Mastering the Pulse of Unix Automation In the intricate infrastructure of Unix-based systems, Cron is the heartbeat of the machine.
- Overview: Crontab Generator & Visualizer is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch Crontab Generator & Visualizer directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Can I use cron to run a job every 30 seconds?
    A: No. Standard Unix crontab has a minimum granularity of one minute. To run a task every 30 seconds, you must use a wrapper script with a sleep command (e.g., * * * * * /my/script.sh && sleep 30 && /my/script.sh) or utilize systemd timers which support microsecond resolution.
  * Q: Why did my cron job fail even with correct syntax?
    A: The most common culprit is the Environment Gap. Cron runs with a very minimal set of environment variables. It likely does not have your standard $PATH. Always use absolute paths for both your script and the binaries inside it (e.g., use /usr/local/bin/python3 instead of just python3).
  * Q: Is my input data private when using this tool?
    A: Yes. Processing runs entirely in your local browser memory. Your inputs and configuration parameters are never uploaded to our servers.

### cURL to Fetch, Axios, Node & Python Converter
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/curl_to_fetch_axios
- Summary: Convert cURL commands to modern JavaScript Fetch API, Axios, Node.js, and Python Requests. Parses methods, headers, and payloads with local browser parsing.
- Overview: Convert cURL terminal commands into production-ready Fetch API, Axios, Node.js, and Python code instantly in your browser. Correctly handles HTTP methods, auth headers, JSON payloads, and form data with local syntax formatting.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Paste cURL Command: Paste your terminal cURL command into the editor, or choose from standard presets like POST JSON or Bearer Auth.
  * Select Target Language: Switch between Fetch API, Axios, Node.js (18+ native fetch), and Python Requests tabs.
  * Inspect Parsed Components: Verify parsed HTTP methods, target URLs, headers, and request body payloads in the breakdown inspector.
  * Copy or Download Code: Click Copy Code to copy formatted snippets with error boundaries or download directly as a .js or .py file.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Why does a cURL command work in terminal but fail with CORS in the browser?
    A: cURL operates directly on the operating system's network sockets and ignores browser security policies. Web browsers enforce the W3C Same-Origin Policy (SOP) and CORS, blocking JavaScript requests to third-party domains unless the server returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers.
  * Q: Does browser fetch reject on HTTP 404 or 500 errors?
    A: No. Unlike Axios, native fetch() resolves successfully on HTTP 4xx and 5xx status codes. You must explicitly check if (!response.ok) to handle API errors.
  * Q: Why shouldn't I set Content-Type manually when sending FormData?
    A: Manually setting Content-Type: multipart/form-data prevents the browser from generating the unique multipart boundary delimiter string (e.g. boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary...), causing the receiving server to reject the upload.

### DuckDB-WASM Parquet & CSV SQL Explorer
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/duckdb_wasm_analytics
- Summary: Query local Parquet and CSV files using client-side SQL in browser memory. Fast columnar analytics, zero data uploads, and exportable result sets.
- Overview: The DuckDB-WASM Parquet & CSV SQL Explorer provides a fast, browser-based SQL analytics workbench for querying local CSV and Apache Parquet data files. All parsing, columnar scanning, and relational filtering execute entirely in your browser memory without transmitting tabular data across the network. Tool inputs are processed locally on your device with no server uploads.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Client-Side SQL Query Execution Engine for CSV and Parquet Datasets
  * Support for Filter (WHERE), Sorting (ORDER BY), Pagination (LIMIT), and Aggregates (COUNT, SUM)
  * Strict Click-to-Load Architecture Preserving Zero Initial Page Load Overhead
  * Interactive Result Grid with Instant CSV and JSON File Export
  * Complete Local Execution with Zero Data Telemetry or Remote Logging
- Procedure Steps:
  * Load Dataset: Drag and drop any local CSV or Parquet file into the upload zone, or click 'Load Sample Dataset' to explore preloaded hardware data.
  * Write SQL Query: Enter standard SQL statements (e.g., SELECT * FROM data WHERE price > 50 ORDER BY price DESC).
  * Execute Query: Click 'Run Query' or press Ctrl+Enter to execute the query against the in-memory tabular data frame.
  * Export Results: Download the filtered and aggregated result set as a clean CSV file or formatted JSON document.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: What is Apache Parquet and why is it faster than CSV?
    A: Apache Parquet is an open-source columnar storage file format. Unlike CSV, which stores data row-by-row as plain text, Parquet stores values column-by-column with dictionary encoding and Snappy/ZSTD compression. This allows SQL query engines to read only the specific columns needed for a query, drastically reducing memory bandwidth [Confirmed: Apache Parquet Specification].
  * Q: Are my confidential spreadsheets or databases uploaded to any cloud server?
    A: No. The entire file reading, schema inference, and SQL execution cycle runs locally in browser RAM using an ArrayBuffer and client-side processing pipeline. Tool inputs are processed locally on your device.
  * Q: What SQL commands are supported in this browser explorer?
    A: The workbench supports SELECT column projections, conditional filtering (WHERE =, !=, >, <, >=, <=), sorting (ORDER BY col ASC/DESC), row limiting (LIMIT n), and common aggregation metrics (COUNT(*), SUM(col)).

### HAR File Sanitizer and Filter
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/har_sanitizer_viewer
- Summary: Sanitize HTTP Archive HAR files by removing cookies, authorization tokens, and API keys locally in your browser before sharing support bundles.
- Overview: Sanitize HTTP Archive (HAR) network recordings by automatically stripping session cookies, Bearer tokens, Authorization headers, and sensitive API keys. All file scrubbing executes locally in browser memory before you share support logs with external vendors.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Comprehensive Authorization and Bearer Token Purge
  * Cookie and Set-Cookie Header Scrubbing
  * Sensitive Query Parameter Redaction (token, password, key)
  * Instant Download of Sanitized .har Artifact
- Procedure Steps:
  * Upload HAR File: Drag and drop your exported .har network recording file into the sanitizer.
  * Review Detected Secrets: Examine identified cookies, auth headers, and sensitive query tokens.
  * Export Sanitized HAR: Click Download Sanitized HAR to generate a safe artifact ready for support submissions.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Why is sharing raw HAR files dangerous?
    A: HTTP Archive files contain complete records of web browser network activity, including session cookies, JWT authentication tokens, OAuth authorization headers, and personal form POST payloads. Sharing unscrubbed HAR files allows recipients to hijack your active account sessions.
  * Q: Which sensitive fields does this tool sanitize?
    A: The tool systematically purges Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie, and custom API token headers, along with query parameters containing keywords such as token, secret, password, key, or apikey.
  * Q: Does sanitization break the network timing data needed by support?
    A: No. Request methods, URLs, response status codes, timing metrics (DNS, SSL, TTFB, download), and header structures remain intact so technical teams can effectively diagnose latency and network errors.

### Local LLM VRAM Calculator
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/llm_vram_calculator
- Summary: Calculate exact VRAM memory requirements for running local LLMs: analyze model weights, quantization formats (Q4_K_M, Q8, FP16), and KV cache context length.
- Overview: The Local LLM VRAM Calculator estimates exact GPU memory requirements for running open-weights language models (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma 2, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek) across different GGUF quantization levels (FP16 down to IQ2) and context window lengths (2k up to 128k tokens). It models model weights, key-value (KV) cache allocation under Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), and CUDA runtime activations. All calculations execute locally in your browser memory.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Pre-Configured Architecture Presets for Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma 2, Qwen 2.5, and DeepSeek
  * GGUF Quantization Precision Modeling (FP16, Q8_0, Q6_K, Q5_K_M, Q4_K_M, Q3_K_S, IQ2_XS)
  * Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) Key-Value (KV) Cache Memory Calculator up to 128k Tokens
  * FP16 and FP8 FlashAttention KV Cache Compression Comparison
  * GPU Hardware Fitting Matrix (8GB, 12GB, 16GB, 24GB, Dual 24GB, and Apple Silicon Unified Memory)
  * Partial GPU Layer Offload Calculator for Hybrid System RAM Setups
- Procedure Steps:
  * Select Model Architecture: Choose a popular open-weights model preset or enter custom parameter counts, layers, and KV head configurations.
  * Choose Quantization Precision: Select your desired GGUF quantization level from unquantized FP16 down to high-efficiency K-quants (Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M) or IQ2.
  * Set Target Context Length: Adjust the context window slider to match your target prompt plus generation token budget (e.g., 8k, 32k, or 128k tokens).
  * Review Hardware Compatibility: Examine the total VRAM footprint breakdown and check which consumer GPUs or Apple Silicon unified memory tiers accommodate the workload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: What is the formula for calculating model weights VRAM?
    A: Model weights memory in gigabytes (GiB) equals (Parameter Count in Billions * Bits per Weight) / (8 * 1.074). For example, an 8.03 billion parameter model at 4.5 bits per weight (Q4_K_M) requires approximately 4.21 GiB of VRAM strictly for weights before loading context buffers.
  * Q: Why does KV cache grow with context length?
    A: During autoregressive inference, the model stores past key and value projection vectors in GPU VRAM to avoid recomputing attention over previous tokens. The memory required equals 2 * Layers * KV_Heads * Head_Dimension * Context_Length * Precision_Bytes. Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) dramatically reduces this compared to standard multi-head attention.
  * Q: What is the difference between Q4_K_M and Q8_0 quantization?
    A: Q8_0 uses 8 bits per weight (~8.5 bits total with scale factors), offering near-lossless output with less than 0.005 perplexity degradation vs FP16. Q4_K_M uses 4-bit medium k-quants (~4.5 bits/weight), reducing memory footprint by nearly 50% while retaining over 98% of benchmark reasoning fidelity.

- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Does this work on Android or mobile devices?
    A: Yes. The LaTeX Math Architect is fully responsive. On Android, you can use the palette buttons to quickly insert complex commands without needing to type backslashes on a virtual keyboard. The SVG export will save directly to your mobile "Downloads" folder, perfect for inserting into study notes on the go.
  * Q: How do I include normal words inside my equation?
    A: By default, LaTeX treats every letter as a variable and italicizes it. If you want to write a normal word (like "Revenue" or "Cost"), you must wrap it in the \text{...} command. For example: \text{Total} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i. This ensures the text looks professional and not like a long string of multiplied variables.
  * Q: Is my math data private?
    A: client-side. All calculations and SVG rendering happen in your browser's local RAM. We do not have a server that receives your math code, and we do not store your results in a database. This tool is "Zero-Knowledge" by design, ensuring your research or strategic formulas remain your proprietary property.

### Probability Distribution Calculator
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/statistical_dist_plot
- Summary: Uncertainty: A Masterclass in Probability Modeling Randomness is not chaos; it is a clinical structure governed by deterministic mathematical laws.
- Overview: Probability Distribution Calculator is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch Probability Distribution Calculator directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: What is the difference between PDF and PMF?
    A: A Probability Density Function (PDF) is used for continuous variables (like the Normal distribution). The probability of a specific exact point (e.g., being exactly 175.0000cm tall) is zero; we instead measure the area under the curve between two points. A Probability Mass Function (PMF) is used for discrete variables (like Binomial or Poisson). It gives the exact probability of a specific count (e.g., getting exactly 5 heads in 10 coin flips).
  * Q: Does this work on Android or mobile?
    A: Perfectly. The visualizer is built with a responsive SVG grid. On Android and iPhone, the sliders and the results panel stack vertically, allowing you to perform quick statistical modeling during a lecture or while in the field. Open Chrome, tap the dots, and select "Add to Home Screen" to use it as an offline PWA.
  * Q: Is my input data private when using this tool?
    A: Yes. Processing runs entirely in your local browser memory. Your inputs and configuration parameters are never uploaded to our servers.

### Regex Visualizer & Debugger
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/regex_flowchart_gen
- Summary: The Architecture of Patterns: A Masterclass in Regular Expression Logic Regular Expressions, or Regex , are the mathematical language of pattern recognition.
- Overview: Regex Visualizer & Debugger is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch Regex Visualizer & Debugger directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Does this visualizer support all Regex flavors?
    A: Our visualizer is optimized for the ECMAScript (JavaScript) and PCRE (Perl Compatible) standards. While most regex flavors (Python, PHP, Ruby) share 95% of the same syntax, some specialized features like named capture groups or recursion may render as literal blocks. We prioritize the standard 'State Machine' components that are universal across all modern programming languages.
  * Q: How do I escape special characters?
    A: If you want to match a character that has special meaning in regex (like $ or .), you must precede it with a backslash (\). For example, \. matches a literal period. In our visualizer, escaped characters are rendered as Literal nodes rather than Anchor or Metacharacter nodes.
  * Q: Is my input data private when using this tool?
    A: Yes. Processing runs entirely in your local browser memory. Your inputs and configuration parameters are never uploaded to our servers.

### Screenshot Secret Redactor & Scanner
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/screenshot_secret_scanner
- Summary: Detect and redact API keys, tokens, credentials, and sensitive private data in pasted screenshots using client-side canvas masks.
- Overview: The Screenshot Secret Redactor & Sensitive Data Scanner inspects pasted images and code snippets for exposed secrets (OpenAI keys, AWS credentials, GitHub tokens, private key headers, and payment numbers). Users can draw custom blackout, blur, or pixelation masks directly on an interactive canvas and copy the sanitized image with one click. Tool inputs are processed locally on your device in browser memory with no server uploads.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Direct Clipboard Paste Support (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) and Drag-and-Drop Image Loading
  * Pre-Configured Regex Pattern Scanning for OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, GitHub, and Slack Tokens
  * Interactive Canvas Masking with Blackout, Gaussian Blur, and Pixelation Brushes
  * Click-and-Drag Custom Bounding Box Redactor for Arbitrary Sensitive Regions
  * One-Click Direct Clipboard Image Export (Copy Redacted PNG) and File Download
- Procedure Steps:
  * Paste Screenshot from Clipboard: Press Ctrl+V (or Cmd+V on macOS) to paste a screenshot directly, or drag and drop an image file into the workspace.
  * Select Redaction Tool: Choose your preferred redaction style: Solid Blackout Box, Gaussian Blur, or Pixelation Mask.
  * Draw Redaction Bounding Boxes: Click and drag across any credentials, email addresses, or proprietary tokens visible in the screenshot.
  * Copy or Download Sanitized Image: Click Copy to Clipboard to immediately paste the redacted screenshot into Slack, Discord, or GitHub issues.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Are my pasted images or credentials sent to any server?
    A: No. All image loading, canvas drawing, pixel filtering, and redaction masking execute entirely within local browser RAM. Tool inputs are processed locally on your device, ensuring zero third-party exposure of sensitive tokens.
  * Q: Why is simple black highlighter sometimes dangerous for redacting text?
    A: Many basic mobile and PDF editors apply semi-transparent black highlighter strokes (e.g., 90% opacity). While text appears obscured to human eyes, brightness and contrast adjustments can recover the underlying text. ToolkitGen draws solid, opaque 100% alpha blackout rectangles directly into the canvas raster, completely replacing the underlying pixels.
  * Q: Which secret token formats are automatically recognized?
    A: The scanner identifies OpenAI project keys (sk-proj-...), Anthropic API keys (sk-ant-...), AWS Access Key IDs (AKIA...), GitHub Personal Access Tokens (ghp_...), Google Cloud API keys (AIza...), Slack webhook tokens, private key headers, and Luhn-validated credit card numbers.

### SQLite WASM Explorer & In-Browser SQL Sandbox
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/sqlite_wasm_explorer
- Summary: Inspect SQLite .db databases, run custom queries, and export results to CSV/JSON in your browser. Powered by WebAssembly with local file processing.
- Overview: Inspect SQLite database files and execute SQL queries directly in your browser using official SQLite WebAssembly. Drag and drop any .db, .sqlite, or .sqlite3 file to analyze schemas, run queries, and export datasets without server uploads.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Load Database File: Drag and drop any .db or .sqlite file into the workspace, or click 'Load Sample Database' to explore a pre-populated schema.
  * Inspect Schema Tables: Click on tables in the schema viewer to preview column data types, primary keys, and foreign key relationships.
  * Execute SQL Query: Type standard SQLite queries (e.g. SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY) into the editor and click Execute or press Ctrl+Enter.
  * Export Query Results: Export the resulting tabular dataset as a standard CSV or JSON file with one click for offline reporting.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Is it safe to open confidential SQLite databases in this browser tool?
    A: Yes. The tool runs official SQLite compiled to WebAssembly (WASM). All database pages are parsed in your browser's local sandbox memory; no database bytes are uploaded to external servers.
  * Q: What SQLite database file formats are supported?
    A: All standard SQLite 3 binary database formats (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3, .db3), including WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) and rollback journal files.
  * Q: Can I modify data or export the modified database file?
    A: Yes. You can execute INSERT, UPDATE, and CREATE TABLE queries in memory and export the updated database file directly to your downloads.

### Text Token Usage Calculator
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/text_token_reducer
- Summary: The Token Economy: Mastering LLM Context Efficiency In the era of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-4, Claude 3.
- Overview: Text Token Usage Calculator is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch Text Token Usage Calculator directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Does stripping stopwords make the AI confused?
    A: In 99% of cases, no. LLMs process text using attention mechanisms that naturally prioritize significant words. Stripping "the" and "a" doesn't change the vector representation of the sentence's meaning. However, if you are asking the AI to perform a task that requires Stylistic Analysis (like "mimic this person's writing style"), you should avoid compression, as the filler words are part of that style.
  * Q: How do I know if I've squeezed too much?
    A: The easiest test is the "Scan Test." Read the squeezed text yourself. If you can still understand the core facts and intent of the data, the AI definitely can. If the text has become a disjointed list of nouns that makes no sense, switch back to "Stopword Stripping" or "Minification" mode.
  * Q: Does this work for Python or JavaScript code?
    A: Yes. For code, always use the Minification mode. This strips out comments and unnecessary indentation. While human developers hate unformatted code, LLMs are trained on billions of lines of it. They find it just as easy (and much cheaper) to parse a one-line function as a beautifully formatted 10-line one.

## Category: Crypto / Security

### Browser Configuration Analyzer
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/browser_fingerprint_id
- Summary: Can Be Tracked Without Cookies For decades, the public's understanding of digital tracking was confined to the "Cookie"—a small text file saved in the browser.
- Overview: Browser Configuration Analyzer is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch Browser Configuration Analyzer directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Does Incognito mode prevent fingerprinting?
    A: No. Standard Incognito mode only prevents your browser from saving cookies and local history on your device. It does nothing to stop a remote server from reading your hardware characteristics. You can verify this by copying the hash in our tool, opening an Incognito window, and seeing that the hash remains identical.
  * Q: Why is my "Uniqueness Score" so high?
    A: The Uniqueness Score is a statistical estimation. Because the number of possible hardware/software combinations is astronomically high ($2^{256}$ or more), the probability of finding another user with the exact same combination of screen resolution, font list, timezone, and canvas rendering is extremely low. Most users are unique within a sample of several million.
  * Q: Can I use this tool on Android or iPhone?
    A: Perfectly. Fingerprinting is especially effective on mobile devices because their hardware (like Apple's A-series chips) and screen resolutions are highly standardized. However, mobile devices also reveal data points like Battery Level and Device Orientation (Gyroscope) that desktop computers do not, potentially making a mobile user even more distinct.

### Data Anonymization Tool
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/data_anonymizer_local
- Summary: The Sovereign Data Standard: Mastering Local PII Anonymization for GDPR and HIPAA In the information economy, data is often compared to oil.
- Overview: Data Anonymization Tool is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch Data Anonymization Tool directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Is my data truly safe from the developer?
    A: 100% Yes. This is the power of the "Local-First" architecture. We do not have a server that receives your text. We do not have a database that logs your input. The entire "Redaction Engine" is a piece of JavaScript that runs on your local CPU. Once you close this tab, the data disappears from your computer's RAM forever. It is a "Zero-Knowledge" system.
  * Q: Does this tool detect human names?
    A: Detecting names with 100% accuracy is the "Holy Grail" of NLP. Because names can be almost any word (e.g., 'Will', 'Rose', 'Mark'), regex-based tools struggle without a massive dictionary. In version 1.0, we prioritize Pattern-Based Identifiers (Email, Phone, IP). For names, we recommend manual oversight or using an "Aggressive Mode" LLM scrubber after the initial local pass.
  * Q: Does this work on Android or mobile browsers?
    A: Perfectly. The PII Data Scrubber is built with a responsive grid system. On Android and iPhone, the input and output panes stack vertically, allowing you to perform quick redactions on snippets from emails or messaging apps while on the move. Open Chrome on Android, tap the dots, and select "Add to Home Screen" to use it as an offline-ready PWA.

### File Protection Utility
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/aes_gcm_vault_local
- Summary: In an era of centralized surveillance and massive data breaches, the concept of Data Sovereignty has moved from a niche concern to a professional necessity.
- Overview: File Protection Utility is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch File Protection Utility directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Can "Quantum Computers" crack AES-256?
    A: According to Grover's Algorithm, a quantum computer would effectively halve the security bits of a symmetric cipher. This means AES-128 would be reduced to 64 bits of security (vulnerable), but AES-256 remains at a robust 128 bits of security even against quantum adversaries. This is why 256-bit keys are considered "Quantum-Resistant" for the foreseeable future.
  * Q: Why does my browser lag during encryption?
    A: Because this is a local-first tool, your computer's CPU is doing all the heavy lifting. The PBKDF2 process (100,000 hashes) and the AES cipher consume significant computational power to ensure security. This lag is a physical manifestation of the work required to protect your file.
  * Q: What happens if Toolkit Gen goes offline?
    A: Since this vault uses standard implementations (Web Crypto API), your files are not "locked" to this specific website. Any tool using AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2-SHA256 can decrypt your file as long as you have the password. Your data security is platform-independent.

### Invisible Image Watermarker
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/invisible_watermark_steno
- Summary: Watermarking &amp; Steganography In an era of rampant content scraping and Generative AI, protecting your digital assets is no longer optional—it's essential.

  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Can I watermark a JPEG image?
    A: You can upload a JPEG to embed data into it, but the output must be saved as a PNG. If you save the result as a JPEG again, the compression algorithm will likely scramble the hidden bits, destroying your watermark.
  * Q: Is this tool secure for private data?
    A: Yes, in terms of data privacy. This tool runs 100% locally in your browser. Your images are never uploaded to our servers. However, standard LSB steganography is not encrypted. Anyone with a similar tool can read the message if they suspect it's there. For sensitive data, encrypt your text (e.g., using AES) before pasting it into the watermark field.
  * Q: What happens if someone resizes the image?
    A: Resizing, cropping, or rotating an image alters the pixel grid arrangement. Because spatial steganography relies on the specific order of pixels to read the binary stream, any geometric transformation will break the watermark. This method is designed for final-stage delivery of digital assets.

### NDEF Tag Content Overwriter & Sanitizer
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/nfc_data_ghost_eraser
- Summary: Sanitize and overwrite readable NDEF records on NFC tags using Web NFC in Chrome on Android. Overwrites user records; cannot format locked hardware sectors.
- Overview: Sanitize NFC tags by overwriting active NDEF payload records with blank zero-byte data using the Web NFC API. Supported in Chrome on Android over HTTPS; cannot format write-locked tags or overwrite proprietary manufacturer memory sectors.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Verify Android Chrome Compatibility: Ensure you are using Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on an Android device with NFC enabled in system settings.
  * Initialize Tag Scanner: Tap 'Scan & Sanitize Tag' and grant the browser permission to access near-field communication hardware.
  * Hold Tag Against NFC Coil: Hold the NFC tag firmly against the upper rear portion of your Android phone until a haptic vibration confirms detection.
  * Verify Overwrite Confirmation: The tool writes an empty NDEF payload to overwrite previous URL, text, or credential records stored on the tag.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Does Web NFC work on iPhone or desktop browsers?
    A: No. The W3C Web NFC specification is implemented exclusively in Chromium-based browsers on Android (Chrome 89+). Apple iOS restricts NFC tag access to native iOS apps via CoreNFC, and desktop operating systems lack standardized consumer NFC reader integrations.
  * Q: Can this tool erase hardware write-locked NFC tags?
    A: No. Standard NFC chips (such as NXP NTAG213, NTAG215, NTAG216) feature physical one-time-programmable (OTP) lock bytes. Once those lock bits are set, the chip's internal logic permanently prevents further writes at the silicon level.
  * Q: What is the difference between NDEF records and raw tag memory?
    A: NDEF (NFC Data Exchange Format) is a standardized data container specification for URLs, vCards, and plain text readable by all smartphones. Raw memory includes manufacturer configuration blocks, password protection bytes, and proprietary memory pages.

### Token Format Viewer
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/jwt_debugger_offline
- Summary: Token Format Viewer: Validate, format, and debug configuration syntax, tokens, and data formats directly in your browser.
- Overview: Token Format Viewer is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing

  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch Token Format Viewer directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Is Base64 the same as encryption?
    A: Absolutely not. Encryption hides information so that it cannot be read without a key. Base64 encoding is merely a way to format data so it can be reliably transmitted across different systems. Any developer can decode a JWT payload in seconds—including with the tool on this page. Always assume the payload is public knowledge.
  * Q: Does this work on Android or mobile?
    A: Perfectly. Our JWT Inspector is built with a responsive grid. On Android and iOS devices, the input and results stack vertically, allowing you to perform quick token audits while on the move or debugging in a mobile browser. Open Chrome on your Android, tap the dots, and select "Add to Home Screen" to use it as an offline PWA.
  * Q: Why doesn't the signature verify when I use the correct key?
    A: The most common reason is Encoding Mismatch. Some systems expect the secret key to be Base64-encoded, while others expect it as a UTF-8 string. Our tool currently expects a UTF-8 string. Additionally, ensure the algorithm in the header is HS256. If your token uses RS256, it requires a Public/Private key pair, which is not supported in this version.

  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Does a crop sensor make my lens "longer"?
    A: Linguistically, we say it makes it longer, but physically, it does not. A 50mm lens is always a 50mm lens. What changes is the Image Circle being captured. The smaller sensor simply cuts off the edges of the image, resulting in a narrower field of view that looks like a longer lens. This is why we use the term 'Equivalent Focal Length'.
  * Q: What is the best focal length for real estate?
    A: For small rooms, you generally want an equivalent focal length of 16mm to 20mm. Anything wider (like 12mm) will cause rooms to look unnaturally distorted and "stretched" at the corners, which can be misleading to buyers. Use the Lens FOV Sim to find the widest setting on your specific sensor before distortion becomes problematic.
  * Q: Does this simulator work on Android?
    A: Perfectly. The tool is designed with a mobile-first responsive grid. On Android and iOS, the viewfinder will scale to your screen width, and the control sliders are touch-optimized for high-precision sliding. You can use this tool on set or in the field to check your framing without needing to swap lenses on your physical camera.

- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: How does eye tracking indicate cognitive load?
    A: Eye tracking reveals cognitive load through several metrics: increased blink rate indicates mental fatigue, longer fixations suggest deep concentration, and pupil dilation correlates with cognitive effort. Together, these patterns help estimate mental workload.
  * Q: What is the 20-20-20 rule for cognitive rest?
    A: Similar to eye strain prevention, the cognitive 20-20-20 rule suggests: Every 20 minutes, look away from your task for 20 seconds at something 20 feet away. This gives your brain a micro-rest and helps maintain sustained attention.
  * Q: Is webcam-based eye tracking accurate?
    A: Webcam-based eye tracking provides estimates, not clinical measurements. It can detect general patterns in blink rate and gaze stability but lacks the precision of dedicated eye tracking hardware used in research settings.

### Magnetic Compass Anomaly & Stud Locator
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/magnetometer_metal_find
- Summary: Locate ferromagnetic wall studs and magnetic anomalies using device compass sensors. Identifies field disturbances on mobile devices with magnetometer sensors.
- Overview: Detect magnetic field disturbances and locate ferromagnetic wall studs using device compass orientation sensors. Mobile browsers read heading flux anomalies to identify structural nails, screws, and conduits behind drywall without requiring native app installations.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Calibrate Compass Sensor: Hold your smartphone flat and move it in a figure-eight pattern for 5 seconds to calibrate internal orientation and magnetometer sensors.
  * Establish Ambient Baseline: Hold the phone in open air away from metal objects to establish the baseline ambient magnetic heading and flux reading.
  * Slowly Sweep Wall Surface: Glide the back of the smartphone smoothly across the drywall surface. Watch for sudden spikes in the magnetic flux deviation needle.
  * Mark Stud Centers: Ferromagnetic drywall screws and structural steel studs cause localized magnetic disturbances. Mark the peak deflection point on the wall.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Can a smartphone actually detect studs in a drywall?
    A: Yes, provided the smartphone has an internal magnetometer sensor and the wall contains ferromagnetic metals (such as steel studs or steel drywall screws driven into wooden studs). The phone detects localized distortions in the Earth's ambient magnetic field.
  * Q: Does this web tool measure absolute magnetic microteslas (µT)?
    A: Standard mobile web browsers provide access to DeviceOrientation and DeviceMotion events, which reflect compass orientation and heading delta. Direct absolute microtesla (µT) access via the Generic Sensor API requires experimental browser flags and HTTPS on Android.
  * Q: Why is figure-eight calibration necessary before scanning?
    A: Smartphone compass sensors suffer from soft-iron and hard-iron bias caused by internal phone components, battery currents, and speaker magnets. The figure-eight motion allows the sensor fusion firmware to subtract local magnetic bias.

### Online Stroboscope
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/stroboscope_tachometer
- Summary: The Physics of Temporal Aliasing: A Masterclass in Stroboscopic Analysis Measurement in the physical world often requires a fixed frame of reference.
- Overview: Online Stroboscope is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory.   * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Why does the "Hz Detected" number fluctuate?
    A: Modern Operating Systems (Windows/macOS) prioritize hundreds of tasks simultaneously. Browsers use requestAnimationFrame, which attempts to sync with your GPU, but "Jitter" can occur if other apps are consuming CPU resources. For maximum measurement accuracy, close all other browser tabs and background applications like Discord or Steam.
  * Q: Can I use this on my Android phone?
    A: Yes. The Software Stroboscope is fully responsive and utilizes the mobile browser's hardware acceleration. In fact, many high-end Android phones now feature 120Hz OLED displays, making them Superior Instruments to standard 60Hz laptops. Open Chrome on your Android, tap the dots, and select "Add to Home Screen" to use it as a standalone tachometer in your workshop.
  * Q: How do I calculate the period of the flash?
    A: The period $T$ is the inverse of the frequency. If you are strobing at 10Hz (600 RPM), the period is $1/10 = 0.1$ seconds (100 milliseconds). If your Duty Cycle is 10%, the screen will be white for 10ms and black for 90ms. This high-speed "Pulse-Width" logic is what creates the freezing effect.

  * Q: Does this tool support Docker Swarm configs?

  * Q: Why is my valid YAML showing an error in Docker?
    A: YAML syntax and Docker schema are two different things. Your file might be syntactically valid YAML (correct indentation) but semantically invalid Docker (using a key that doesn't exist, like imge: instead of image:). Our tool checks for syntax errors, but always cross-reference with the official Docker Compose specification for newer attributes.

### Internet Stability Test

  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Why is jitter more important for gaming than download speed?
    A: In gaming, the amount of data transferred is actually very small (measured in kilobytes). However, the timing of that data is everything. If you shoot a target, that 'shot' packet must arrive at the server in a predictable timeframe. If jitter is high, the server sees your movements at erratic intervals, leading to "desync" or "teleporting." Speed (bandwidth) is the size of the truck; Jitter is the smoothness of the road. You can have a big truck, but if the road is full of potholes, your cargo will be late or damaged.
  * Q: Does this work on Android or mobile phones?
    A: Absolutely. The analyzer is fully responsive and uses the mobile-compatible Fetch API. On Android, it is particularly useful for identifying "Dead Zones" in your home. We recommend starting the analysis, walking from room to room, and watching the Jitter Val in real-time. If you see it spike as you enter a specific room, you've identified a Wi-Fi blind spot that might need a repeater or mesh node.
  * Q: Is my data private while running the test?
    A: client-side. Unlike cloud-based tools that harvest your IP address and ISP details to sell to marketing firms, Toolkit Gen's Jitter Analyzer is a local-first application. All calculations happen in your browser's RAM. We do not store your network logs or track your location. This is zero-knowledge networking auditing for the sovereign user.

### Manual AR Wi-Fi Heatmap Planner & Signal Drop Estimator
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/wifi_dead_zone_logger
- Summary: Map domestic Wi-Fi coverage by plotting estimated signal drop across floor plans. Modern web browsers cannot read raw Wi-Fi RSSI or BSSID directly due to OS isolation.
- Overview: Calculate domestic Wi-Fi signal attenuation and chart dead zones through visual distance estimation and browser downlink telemetry. Web browsers cannot access raw Wi-Fi chipsets or RSSI dBm values directly due to operating system security isolation.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Camera and Distance Setup: Launch the visual planner and grant camera access to project markers into your physical workspace.
  * Map Signal Attenuation: Walk toward rooms experiencing signal drops while logging estimated downlinks and physical obstructions like drywall, concrete, or metal.
  * Evaluate Attenuation Table: Cross-reference signal drops with the material attenuation table to identify physical barriers absorbing 2.4GHz and 5GHz frequencies.
  * Export Layout Findings: Export your obstruction list and layout observations to reposition your router or configure a dedicated mesh backhaul node.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Can web browsers measure exact Wi-Fi signal strength in dBm?
    A: No. The W3C and major browser vendors intentionally do not expose raw Wi-Fi RSSI (received signal strength indicator) or BSSID (access point MAC address) to web applications to prevent geographic location fingerprinting. Browsers only expose estimated connection downlink metrics via navigator.connection.
  * Q: Why does 5 GHz Wi-Fi drop through walls faster than 2.4 GHz?
    A: According to electromagnetic propagation physics, higher frequencies attenuate faster when penetrating solid matter. While 5 GHz provides wider channel widths and higher throughput, solid materials like concrete, brick, and tile absorb 5 GHz waves at nearly double the decibel loss of 2.4 GHz waves.
  * Q: How does domestic material attenuation cause dead zones?
    A: Drywall and interior wood doors typically cause 2 to 5 dB of signal loss. In contrast, masonry, brick, reinforced concrete, and metal-backed mirrors cause 15 to 30 dB of loss, which can attenuate over 95% of radio frequency energy, producing an immediate dead zone behind the barrier.

### Universal 'AirDrop' (P2P WebRTC)
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/airdrop_web_universal
- Summary: Universal 'AirDrop' (P2P WebRTC): Format, encrypt, and convert document data locally on your device with complete processing privacy.
- Overview: Universal 'AirDrop' (P2P WebRTC) is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch Universal 'AirDrop' (P2P WebRTC) directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: What is the maximum file size limit for Universal AirDrop?
    A: Technically, there is no hard-coded limit because file transfers stream directly between peer devices over WebRTC. However, we recommend a soft limit of 500MB to 1GB per individual file when using mobile devices. Because the transfer protocol temporarily utilizes your web browser's active memory (RAM) as an intermediary buffer, attempting to send an extremely large file (such as a 10GB 4K movie) in a single chunk might cause the browser tab to crash or refresh on older smartphones with limited memory. For massive data transfers, we highly recommend sending multiple smaller files.
  * Q: Does Universal AirDrop use my cellular internet data to send files?
    A: No, it does not consume your data plan for the actual file transfer. When using the "Online Connect" mode, the application uses an infinitesimally small amount of internet data (approximately 2 to 5 Kilobytes) to communicate with the signaling server just long enough to generate the 4-digit PIN. Once the "Secure Link Active" badge appears, the internet connection is bypassed entirely. A 5GB file will then transfer directly over your local Wi-Fi router, resulting in 0MB of cellular data usage.
  * Q: Why is my transfer speed slow, or why won't the devices connect?
    A: WebRTC connectivity issues usually stem from router configurations. If the devices are stuck on "Connecting...", you may be on a corporate VPN, a strict school network, or a public Wi-Fi access point that enables "Client Isolation" (a security setting that prevents devices on the same Wi-Fi from seeing each other). If the connection establishes but the speed is crawling, ensure both devices are connected to the 5GHz frequency band of your router, rather than the congested 2.4GHz band. If all else fails, use the Offline Hotspot mode, which forces a direct, unhindered connection between the two device's network cards.

### Amsler Grid (Macular Degeneration)

- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Can I perform this test on a mobile phone?
    A: Yes. However, screen size matters. On a phone, hold the device about 12 inches away. A tablet or desktop monitor is often preferred as it covers a larger area of your peripheral central vision. Ensure your screen brightness is set to high to maintain contrast.
  * Q: Why do I need to cover one eye?
    A: This is crucial. If you keep both eyes open, your "good" eye will compensate for the "bad" eye, and your brain will essentially Photoshop out the blind spots or wavy lines. You must test each eye independently to detect defects.
  * Q: Does this test replace my annual eye exam?
    A: No. The Amsler Grid screens for macular problems specifically. It does not check for glaucoma (peripheral vision loss), cataracts, or prescription changes. You still need a comprehensive dilated eye exam annually, especially if you are over 60.

- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Do blue-blocking glasses really work?
    A: Yes, but only if they are Orange or Red tinted. Clear "blue light" glasses often only block 5-10% of HEV light. To effectively protect melatonin, you need lenses that block everything below 500nm, which will physically change the color of the world you see to a warm amber.
  * Q: Is blue light dangerous for my eyes?
    A: While there is some concern about macular degeneration, the primary danger of modern light exposure is Circadian Misalignment. Short-term, it causes insomnia; long-term, chronic melatonin suppression is linked to increased risk of metabolic syndrome and certain cancers.

    A: No. The simulation is purely visual. We apply an SVG filter overlay to the rendered image in your browser tab. Your original source file remains untouched. This allows you to rapidly toggle between different vision modes without ever corrupting your source assets.
  * Q: What is the difference between "Anomalous Trichromacy" and "Dichromacy"?
    A: Anomalous Trichromacy means one of the three cone types is shifted in sensitivity—color perception is weakened but not gone. Dichromacy (which our tool simulates) means one cone type is completely missing. By designing for Dichromacy (the "Worst Case Scenario"), you automatically ensure that your designs are accessible to those with Anomalous Trichromacy as well.

    A: On Android, simply open this page in Chrome or your native browser. Tap the "Upload Your Design" button to select a screenshot from your gallery. You can then tap the simulation buttons at the bottom to audit your mobile UI designs on the go. For the best experience, open Chrome, tap the three dots, and select "Add to Home Screen" to use the Sim as an offline PWA.

  * Q: Can I measure PD without a webcam?
    A: Yes. You can use the physical "Mirror Method". Stand about 8 inches from a bathroom mirror. Hold a millimeter ruler flat against your eyebrows. Close your right eye and align the ruler's 0mm mark exactly with the center of your left pupil. Without moving the ruler, open your right eye, close your left, and read the millimeter mark that aligns with your right pupil.

### Screen Flicker & Rolling Shutter Banding Detector
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/pwm_flicker_eye_health_scanner
- Summary: Detect visible OLED and LCD screen flicker and pulse-width modulation (PWM) using camera rolling shutter banding. Visual screening tool, not a photodiode meter.
- Overview: Identify pulse-width modulation (PWM) display flicker by observing rolling shutter dark interference bands through your camera. Provides a rapid visual presence test to detect screen flicker without needing dedicated laboratory photodiode equipment.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Prepare Display Screen: Open a solid white image or blank document on the screen you wish to inspect and lower display brightness to 25% to 50%.
  * Align Smartphone Camera: Point your smartphone camera at the target screen at a distance of 4 to 8 inches (10 to 20 cm) and focus carefully.
  * Observe Rolling Shutter Banding: Look for traveling horizontal black and gray bars across the camera viewfinder. Thick, visible bands indicate active pulse-width modulation.
  * Compare at 100% Brightness: Increase screen brightness to 100%. If the dark bands disappear or become uniform, the display uses PWM duty-cycle dimming at lower brightness levels.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: How does camera rolling shutter detect display flicker?
    A: CMOS camera sensors read pixel rows sequentially from top to bottom (rolling shutter). When a display uses PWM to dim its backlight by flashing rapidly on and off, the sensor captures illuminated rows when the backlight is ON and dark bands when the backlight is OFF.
  * Q: Can a smartphone camera measure exact PWM flicker frequency in kHz?
    A: No. Smartphone camera rolling shutter frame rates and exposure times are typically limited to between 1/30s and 1/8000s, which can visually reveal flicker up to approximately 480Hz. Precise measurement of high-frequency (e.g. 1920Hz to 3840Hz) flicker requires an optical photodiode connected to an oscilloscope.
  * Q: Why does low-frequency PWM cause headaches and eye strain?
    A: Even when screen flicker is too fast to be consciously perceived, the human retina and pupillary sphincter muscles continuously respond to rapid light pulses. This causes micro-contractions in eye muscles, resulting in asthenopia (eye strain), migraines, and visual fatigue.

  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Does squinting help astigmatism?
    A: Yes, temporarily. Squinting creates a "pinhole effect" which increases depth of field and reduces the amount of aberrant light rays entering the eye. It also physically alters the eye shape via eyelid pressure. However, it causes significant muscle strain and headaches over time.
  * Q: Can astigmatism go away naturally?
    A: Typically, no. Astigmatism is a structural shape issue. While it often changes (the axis can shift as eyelid tension changes with age), it rarely resolves completely on its own in adults. Children may sometimes outgrow mild astigmatism as the eye develops.
  * Q: What is Keratoconus?
    A: Keratoconus is a progressive eye disease where the cornea thins and bulges into a cone shape, causing irregular astigmatism. If the lines on the fan chart look wavy or bent rather than just blurred, consult a doctor immediately.

## Category: Audio / Sound

### Acoustic Earbud Seal & Sub-Bass Isolation Test
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/spatial_audio_seal_tester
- Summary: Evaluate in-ear monitor (IEM) acoustic fit and sub-bass seal integrity using psychoacoustic 20Hz-60Hz audio sweeps and stereo phase cancellation tones.
- Overview: Test the acoustic seal and sub-bass isolation of in-ear monitors (IEMs) using calibrated 20Hz-60Hz audio sweeps and phase cancellation. Weak sub-bass or phase imbalance indicates an inadequate ear tip seal that compromises frequency response.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Insert In-Ear Monitors: Fit your earbuds with your preferred ear tips (silicone or memory foam) and insert them firmly into your ear canals.
  * Set Moderate Volume: Adjust system audio to a comfortable, moderate listening volume. Never test sub-bass tones at maximum volume.
  * Play 30Hz-50Hz Sub-Bass Tone: Activate the sub-bass test tone. A proper acoustic seal produces a deep, visceral rumble inside both ears. If the tone sounds tinny or faint, the seal is broken.
  * Test Stereo Phase Cancellation: Switch to out-of-phase mode. An airtight bilateral seal will make the audio sensation feel completely hollow and centered inside your head.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Why is an airtight earbud seal essential for sub-bass response?
    A: In-ear monitor drivers operate inside a tiny, sealed acoustic chamber formed between the ear tip and the eardrum. If there is even a microscopic air leak, low-frequency air pressure escapes, causing sub-bass frequencies below 100Hz to attenuate by up to 20 to 30 dB.
  * Q: How does a psychoacoustic phase cancellation test detect acoustic leaks?
    A: By playing identical low-frequency tones with inverted phase (180 degrees out of phase) between the left and right channels, an acoustic leak in one ear disrupts phase balance, causing sound to perceptually localize toward the unsealed ear.
  * Q: What are the telltale symptoms of an inadequate earbud seal?
    A: Symptoms include thin, tinny audio reproduction, lack of bass impact below 80Hz, excessive penetration of ambient background noise, and earbuds slipping out during jaw movement.

  * Q: What is Tinnitus?

  * Q: Can I hear 20,000Hz?
    A: Only if you are very young (usually under 15) or have exceptional genetics. 20,000Hz is the theoretical limit of the human ear. For most adults, anything above 18,000Hz is simply beyond the biological capacity of the stereocilia.

  * Q: Why does the "pip" sound like it's clicking?

### CPR Metronome (100-120 BPM) & Chest Pace Coach
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/cpr_metronome_bpm
- Summary: American Heart Association (AHA) and ERC compliant 100-120 BPM audio metronome with visual pacing bar and 30:2 compression guide for hands-only CPR.
- Overview: Maintain life-saving chest compressions at 100 to 120 beats per minute using a Web Audio metronome and visual compression guide. Aligned with American Heart Association (AHA) and European Resuscitation Council (ERC) guidelines to maintain optimal coronary perfusion during cardiac arrest.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Call Emergency Dispatch: Immediately dial 911 (or your local emergency number) and put the dispatcher on speaker before starting compressions.
  * Position Hands on Sternum: Place the heel of your primary hand on the center of the chest (lower half of breastbone), lace your other hand on top, and lock your elbows straight.
  * Start 110 BPM Metronome: Activate the audio metronome and synchronize your chest compressions with the rhythmic click and visual pulse bar.
  * Maintain 2-Inch Depth: Push hard and fast to a depth of 2 to 2.4 inches (5 to 6 cm) on adults, allowing full chest recoil between every compression.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: What is the recommended CPR compression rate in 2026?
    A: 100 to 120 compressions per minute, established by the American Heart Association (AHA) and European Resuscitation Council (ERC). Compressing within this window ensures sufficient blood flow to the brain and vital organs.
  * Q: Why is compressing faster than 120 BPM dangerous?
    A: Compressing too fast does not allow the heart chambers enough time to refill with venous blood between compressions (diastolic filling time), significantly reducing coronary perfusion pressure.
  * Q: What is the difference between Hands-Only CPR and conventional CPR?
    A: Hands-Only CPR involves continuous chest compressions without rescue breaths and is strongly recommended for untrained bystanders witnessing sudden adult collapse. Conventional CPR with 30:2 compressions-to-breaths is used by trained rescuers and for drowning or pediatric cardiac arrests.

  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Why do my speakers sound better out of phase?
    A: If the Out-of-Phase test sounds "fuller" or has more bass than the In-Phase test, this is an absolute confirmation that your system's physical wiring is inverted. One of your speakers is currently wired with positive and negative swapped. This results in the speakers working against each other during normal playback. Reverse the wires on ONLY ONE speaker to fix this instantly.
  * Q: Does this work on Bluetooth speakers?
    A: Yes. However, many portable Bluetooth speakers (like small cylindrical ones) use DSP (Digital Signal Processing) to sum audio to mono or to expand the soundstage artificially. If "Left Only" plays out of both ends of a single portable speaker, it's because the hardware doesn't have true stereo separation. This tool is ideal for testing TWS (True Wireless Stereo) earbuds where one bud might be lagging or misconfigured.
  * Q: Is my audio data private?
    A: client-side. All signal generation and panning calculations happen locally in your browser's RAM. We do not upload any audio, and we don't record your testing sessions. This tool is a "Zero-Knowledge" diagnostic utility, ensuring your professional acoustic environment remains your proprietary secret.

### Microphone Input Lag Test
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/mic_latency_loopback
- Summary: Free online microphone latency loopback test with instant results. No account required. Calculations run in your browser, and inputs are not uploaded.
- Overview: Microphone Latency Loopback Test is a free online utility built for developers, designers, and professionals. It runs directly on your device using standard HTML5 APIs and WebAssembly. No signup or account is required. Calculations run locally in your browser, and your input parameters or files are not uploaded to our servers.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Open Tool: Launch Microphone Input Lag Test directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.
  * Instant Calculation: Review real-time calculations or interactive visualizations generated on-device with instant local execution.
  * Export or Copy: Copy results to clipboard or download files with direct browser download and no data upload.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Why is my browser latency different from my DAW?
    A: Browsers use the Web Audio API, which is built on top of the shared system audio engine. It adds a safety buffer (usually 1024 samples) to ensure that audio from background tabs or YouTube doesn't stutter. A DAW (Digital Audio Workstation) using exclusive ASIO drivers can bypass these safety buffers, reaching much lower latency than is possible in a browser window. Treat this tool as your 'Worst Case' baseline.
  * Q: Is my microphone data private?
    A: client-side. Privacy is a core architecture principle of Toolkit Gen. The audio from your microphone is processed locally in your browser's RAM using the High-Resolution Time API. No audio is recorded, stored, or transmitted to any server. Once you close this tab, the analysis buffer is purged.
  * Q: What is the "Ping" test doing exactly?
    A: The tool generates a 'Transient Pulse'—a sharp, single-frame click. It starts a high-precision timer at the exact microsecond the speaker is told to play. The engine then listens to the microphone for a specific energy spike in the 1kHz range. The time difference between the 'Click Out' and the 'Click In' is your Total Round-Trip Latency.

The only effective strategy is Prevention through monitoring and ear protection.

### Spatial Audio HRTF Simulator & Virtual Surround Calibrator
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/hrtf_spatial_audio_profiler
- Summary: Simulate 3D spatial audio positioning and binaural room impulse responses using head-related transfer function models in the Web Audio API.
- Overview: Simulate 3D spatial audio cues and headphone surround localization using head-related transfer function (HRTF) algorithms in the Web Audio API. Provides algorithmic sound positioning to test stereo imaging and pinna filtering effects.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory
- Procedure Steps:
  * Wear Stereo Headphones: Put on standard over-ear or in-ear stereo headphones. Disable any external virtual surround sound DSP processing in your OS.
  * Calibrate Head Dimensions: Adjust the estimated interaural time difference (ITD) slider to match your head circumference and ear spacing.
  * Position Virtual Sound Source: Drag the 3D sound node across azimuth (horizontal angle), elevation (vertical angle), and distance coordinates.
  * Evaluate Binaural Localization: Listen to the simulated frequency coloration and interaural time delays to test your acoustic soundstage localization.
- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: How does HRTF simulate 3D audio in ordinary stereo headphones?
    A: Head-Related Transfer Functions (HRTF) model the precise acoustic filtering that occurs as sound waves bounce off your shoulders, head, and ear pinna folds before entering the ear canal. By applying these frequency-dependent filters and microsecond time delays, stereo headphones can convincingly place sounds in 3D space.
  * Q: Can a browser camera scan real ear pinna geometry accurately?
    A: No. High-accuracy custom HRTF generation requires multi-camera photogrammetry or laser scanning to build an exact 3D mesh of the outer ear, followed by boundary element method (BEM) acoustic simulations. Browser tools use parametric approximations based on head radius.
  * Q: What is the difference between generic HRTF and personalized SOFA files?
    A: Generic HRTF profiles (like the KEMAR acoustic dummy head standardized in the W3C Web Audio PannerNode) use average human measurements. Personalized SOFA (Spatially Oriented Format for Acoustics) files contain measured impulse responses tailored to an individual's unique ear anatomy.

### Speaker Phase & Polarity Test
- URL: https://toolkitgen.com/tool/stereo_phase_test
- Summary: Defines Your Auditory Fidelity Sound is more than volume; it is a physical interaction of air molecules controlled by the Geometric Phase of your speakers.
- Overview: Speaker Phase & Polarity Test is a browser-based utility developed for professionals requiring immediate results without server dependencies. It executes all calculations locally on your client device using modern Web APIs, ensuring that your inputs, files, and diagnostic data remain within browser memory. No registration or software installation is required.
- Key Capabilities:
  * Local Browser Processing
  * Instant Calculation
  * no server uploads & Zero Logging
  * Works Offline in Browser Memory

  * Open Tool: Launch Speaker Phase & Polarity Test directly in your browser on ToolkitGen. No account creation or installation needed.
  * Configure Input: Input your data, adjust slider parameters, or upload files directly into the client-side workspace.

- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: Does this work on Bluetooth speakers?
    A: Yes. However, many portable Bluetooth speakers use DSP (Digital Signal Processing) to widen the soundstage artificially. This can sometimes make the In-Phase setting sound a bit 'wide'. For a true test, ensure any '3D Sound' or 'Spatial Audio' settings on your device are turned OFF before running the diagnostic.
  * Q: Can one speaker be out of phase with itself?
    A: In 3-way speakers, it is possible for the Tweeter to be out of phase with the Woofer inside the cabinet. This is a common manufacturing error. If your vocals sound thin but your bass is strong, use the 4kHz (Crisp) test. If that setting sounds hollow while 80Hz sounds solid, your tweeter wiring is likely reversed.
  * Q: Why do I feel pressure in my head during the Out-of-Phase test?
    A: This is a physiological reaction to Phase Incoherence. Because the sound waves are arriving at your ears with inverted pressure, your brain's spatial processing center (the Medial Superior Olive) cannot reconcile the data. It feels like 'anti-sound' or a vacuum. This is a normal part of the test and is the most reliable way to confirm an out-of-phase condition!

### Tone Frequency Matcher

- Frequent Questions:
  * Q: What if I have multiple tones?
    A: This is common and is known as "Polyphonic Tinnitus." We recommend matching the most dominant (loudest) tone first. For notched therapy, you can notch multiple frequencies, though a single dominant match usually provides the most significant relief.
  * Q: Can headphones affect the match?
    A: Yes. Different headphones have different "frequency responses." Some earbuds boost bass, while others boost treble. For the most accurate clinical match in this tool, use wired over-ear "Studio Monitor" style headphones which have a flatter, more honest sound profile.
  * Q: Is my input data private when using this tool?
